evals.prompt: Design the Buy order ticket for Nestlé on iPhone with Bridge.
evals.expected_output: A top-to-bottom screen spec naming each component with its origin, key properties and tokens, the review step with fees, states, accessibility notes and gaps.
expectations: Uses Buttons Buy-Sell [Mobile] with a label naming the order
Top app bar and segmented control are [Native]
Shows estimated cost and fees before confirmation
Lists loading, market closed, insufficient funds and rejected states
Only token names that exist in the index
